name: coverage
description: The gauntlet's peer-floor loss census Tools/gauntlet/harness/coverage.mjs (#6756) and its Jet twin Tools/gauntlet/harness/coverage/run.jet over the kit's Coverage module, #5072 c8, both over the repository's own coverage corpus. The fixture's gauntlet report gives binparse a rust wall loss, a c loss on its own time metric and on memory, a win, a not-applicable metric, a declared non-applicable peer, a reading with a reason and one with a zero ratio, and sieve two rust losses; its ScriptBench cells give w01 a python wall loss, a node wall win past the timeout, a bun wall loss without a ratio and a bun memory loss, and w05 a memory loss owned by two cards, beside a report-only tier the census ignores. Cases: the census lines and totals; the same with --out and --require-empty, whose census file the check reads; a report that is not JSON; and three argument errors. The check keeps the corpus issues, the losses, the totals' readings and losses and the uncovered readings of the programs fixtures/watched.txt names, as the corpus grows on its own.
